lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: You haven't slept properly since the Vendor of Ghosts.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The faces accumulate. The Dominion kept those memories buried. Without them, the faces were just absence. Now they surface.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Kade's signal came through encrypted. Claims he has evidence of a black Lotus program, using pollen to reshape operative conditioning. Force the truth up, then bury it again deeper.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: It's a trap, Cipher. Could be.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The Dominion doesn't set traps for ghosts.

lines.speaker: Vess
lines.text: You're volunteering.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Before anyone else speaks.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: The pollen doesn't distinguish memory from nightmare. You'll see things down there that aren't real, and things that are. You won't know which is which.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Good. I'm tired of not seeing them.

lines.speaker: Lotus Enforcer 1
lines.text: Unidentified vessel! This is a restricted sector! Disengage or face termination!

lines.speaker: Lotus Enforcer 2
lines.text: Three contacts descending! Move to intercept!

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: First wave down. Moving to checkpoint two.

lines.speaker: Lotus Enforcer 3
lines.text: Blade signature locked! Engage combat protocol!

lines.speaker: Kade
lines.text: Thirty-seven operatives. Cycled through the Lotus program.

lines.speaker: Kade
lines.text: Most were reshaped. The rest lost to permanent dreamstate.

lines.speaker: Kade
lines.text: I helped choose the test subjects.

lines.speaker: Kade
lines.text: I have been sorry every day since.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Your vitals are fluctuating. Pollen concentration rising. Stay inside. Don't fight the exposure.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Six hours and your system will flush it. Hold steady.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: I acknowledge.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The pollen's here. It's thick. I can barely...

lines.speaker: Lotus Warrior
lines.text: You are the choice that costs everything. We are the obedience you ran from.

lines.speaker: Khall
lines.text: The Lotus does not show lies.

lines.speaker: Khall
lines.text: It shows what you already know but cannot say out loud.

lines.speaker: Khall
lines.text: You refused at Kethel-7. You remember that refusal now.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: You're not real. You're the pollen showing me what I fear.

lines.speaker: Khall
lines.text: Does it matter if we are real or if we are fear? The order remains. The refusal remains. The cost remains.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: I am killing the same figure in an endless loop.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: You are me.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Every order I obeyed when I knew better. Every moment I chose the Dominion over what I could see in front of me.

lines.speaker: Girl (Age Nine)
lines.text: You came.

lines.speaker: Girl (Age Nine)
lines.text: You saw us.

lines.speaker: Girl (Age Nine)
lines.text: You refused.

lines.speaker: Girl (Age Nine)
lines.text: You did not forget us.

lines.speaker: Girl (Age Nine)
lines.text: They tried to take that from you, but you held it.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: I refused the order.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: I knew what it would cost me.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: I chose it anyway.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: And I would choose it again.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Where are you? Where is the choice that broke me?

lines.speaker: Kade
lines.text: Minutes. Only minutes passed.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Your vitals crashed. Exposure maximum. Extraction team inbound!

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: I'm awake.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Khall is using the Lotus to reshape newer operatives.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Forcing the truth up from wherever it was buried, then rebuilding over it. That makes it dangerous to someone whose whole program depends on keeping that truth buried.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Then he'll come for this. And he'll bring everything.

lines.speaker: Lotus Commander
lines.text: Intruder still mobile! Seal the primary exit! Contain the purge!

lines.speaker: Lotus Guard 1
lines.text: Structural integrity failing! Retreat to secondary!

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Clear the exit! Grab-beam is live!

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Thirty-seven operatives run through the program. Twenty-three "successfully reshaped." The rest, lost. One file stops cold.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Operative Ronin-8. Currently suspended in long-term dreamstate.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: I thought I was a mistake. A one-off. I didn't know there was a program with a numbering system.

lines.speaker: Vess
lines.text: How many?

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: The file doesn't say. But there's a numbering pattern. The ledger could span decades.

lines.speaker: Dominion Elite Operative 1
lines.text: Intruders contained. Initiate retrieval protocol.

lines.speaker: Dominion Elite Operative 2
lines.text: Formation delta. Lethal authorization.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Dorsal container! Now!

lines.speaker: Dominion Elite Operative 3
lines.text: Are you the one they call broken?

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: Dominion Elite Operative 3
lines.text: I wanted to refuse. I have always wanted to refuse.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: If there is a Ronin-8, how many were there before me?

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: How many are active now?

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: I don't have that answer. But whatever it is, it's worse than we thought.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Three more squads converging on your position! Moving to sector four!

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Clear sector three! Moving down!

lines.speaker: Khall
lines.text: I needed to know if the break was a choice or a flaw.

lines.speaker: Khall
lines.text: Because one of those I can correct and one of those I cannot.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: It was a choice. At Kethel-7 I looked at those children and I chose.

lines.speaker: Khall
lines.text: Then you are more dangerous than the chip ever made you.

lines.speaker: Ronin-8
lines.text: Where... where am I?

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Awake. You are awake now.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Cipher! Facility collapse imminent! Extract now!

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Ronin-8 and the others are awake now. Twenty-three operatives we freed from those tanks. But the numbering system means there are more, how many, we still don't know.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: That facility was just a cache. If they numbered operatives that high, the program spans further than any of us can measure.
